items.guidance: In this Koa server, find the app.listen call and the config module that supplies its port, and check what the start-prod script runs. If the port comes from a config default or an environment variable with a name other than PORT, use that default for EXPOSE in Dockerfile.server and report the variable name so the vendor can set it in Deployz.

Check the Koa router and route files for an existing ping or status route that needs no session before adding one. If you add one, register it as an early middleware or router entry ahead of the session, authentication, and any redirect middleware, and return 200 with a short body without a database query.

Search for where pg-boss is created and where its start, work, or schedule calls are made, and check whether the server entry that start-prod runs imports that code. Report the file, whether the web process starts the job runner, and any separate script or CLI command that starts it alone. Also report which database connection pg-boss uses, because it keeps its jobs in PostgreSQL.

The evidence file is under packages/app-clipper/content_scripts, which by its path may be browser extension code and not server code. Check whether the image built from Dockerfile.server includes or runs this file. Report whether the SQS reference runs on the server, the queue name or URL it uses, and which process produces and consumes the messages.
